title: AI video startup, Higgsfield, founded by ex-Snap exec, lands $1.3B valuation
description: Higgsfield says it's on a $200 million annual revenue run rate. So it opened its previous Series A round back up and sold another $80 million in shares.
author: Julie Bort

title: The US imposes 25% tariff on Nvidia’s H200 AI chips headed to China
description: The Trump administration formalized its 25% cut of H200 chip sales in China with a tariff that applies to certain semiconductors.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: OpenAI invests in Sam Altman’s brain computer interface startup Merge Labs
description: Merge Labs is a “research lab” dedicated to “bridging biological and artificial intelligence to maximize human ability.” OpenAI wrote the largest check in Merge Labs' $250 million seed round at an $850 million valuation.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Wikimedia Foundation announces new AI partnerships with Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Perplexity, and others
description: The AI partnerships allow companies to access the org's content, like Wikipedia, at scale.
author: Sarah Perez

title: US senators demand answers from X, Meta, Alphabet, and others on sexualized deepfakes
description: In a letter to the leaders of X, Meta, Alphabet, Snap, Reddit, and TikTok, several U.S. senators are demanding the companies provide proof that they have "robust protections and policies" in place, and how they plan to curb the rise of sexualized deepfakes on their platforms.
author: Ram Iyer, Rebecca Bellan

title: Parloa triples its valuation in 8 months to $3B with $350M raise
description: The massive round was led by existing investor General Catalyst, with participation from other returning backers.
author: Marina Temkin

title: After Italy, WhatsApp excludes Brazil from rival chatbot ban
description: WhatsApp is allowing AI providers to continue offering their chatbots to users in Brazil, days after the country's competition agency ordered the company to suspend its new policy that bars third-party, general-purpose chatbots from the app.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Mira Murati’s startup, Thinking Machines Lab, is losing two of its co-founders to OpenAI
description: The abrupt change in personnel was in the works for several weeks, according to an OpenAI executive.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: India’s Emversity doubles valuation as it scales workers AI can’t replace
description: Emversity has raised $30 million in a new round as it scales job-ready training in India.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Musk denies awareness of Grok sexual underage images as California AG launches probe
description: The California attorney general has opened a formal investigation into Elon Musk's xAI after its chatbot Grok began generating nonconsensual sexual images of real women and even children.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: OpenAI signs deal, worth $10B, for compute from Cerebras
description: The collaboration will help OpenAI's models deliver faster response times for more difficult or time-consuming tasks, the companies said.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: The multibillion-dollar AI security problem enterprises can’t ignore
description: AI agents are supposed to make work easier. But they’re also creating a whole new category of security nightmares.  As companies deploy AI-powered chatbots, agents, and copilots across their operations, they’re facing a new risk: How do you let employees and AI agents use powerful AI tools without accidentally leaking sensitive data, violating compliance rules, or opening […]
author: Rebecca Bellan, Theresa Loconsolo

title: AI models are starting to crack high-level math problems
description: Since the release of GPT 5.2, AI tools have become inescapable in high-level mathematics.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Google’s Trends Explore page gets new Gemini capabilities
description: The Trends Explore page for users to analyze search interest just got a major upgrade. It now uses Gemini to identify and compare relevant trends.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Robotics software maker Skild AI hits $14B valuation
description: Skild AI, which is building general-purpose robotic software, just raised a $1.4 billion funding round led by SoftBank.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Gemini’s new beta feature provides proactive responses based on your photos, emails, and more
description: Personal Intelligence is off by default, as users have the option to choose if and when they want to connect their Google apps to Gemini.
author: Aisha Malik

title: AI security firm, depthfirst, announces $40 million Series A
description: The company used an AI-native platform to help companies fight threats.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: VoiceRun nabs $5.5M to build a voice agent factory
description: VoiceRun, a startup that creates voice agents, raised $5.5 million in a round led by FlyBridge.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: Microsoft announces glut of new data centers but says it won’t let your electricity bill go up
description: The tech giant has pledged to be a "good neighbor" as it continues to invest in AI infrastructure throughout the country.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: A consumer watchdog issued a warning about Google’s AI agent shopping protocol —  Google says she’s wrong
description: A consumer economics watchdog says Google's new Universal Commerce Protocol is ripe for misuse where consumers could pay more for items. Google denies this.
author: Julie Bort

title: Ring founder details the camera company’s ‘intelligent assistant’ era
description: AI is ushering in Ring’s next chapter, as the Amazon-owned video doorbell maker shifts toward becoming an “intelligent assistant.”
author: Sarah Perez

title: Doctors think AI has a place in healthcare – but maybe not as a chatbot
description: OpenAI and Anthropic have each launched healthcare-focused products over the last week.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Neo humanoid maker 1X releases world model to help bots learn what they see
description: 1X released a new world model that it says is a solid step toward its robots being able to teach themselves new tasks.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: ElevenLabs CEO says the voice AI startup crossed $330M ARR last year
description: The company said it took only five months to go from $200 million to $330 million in annual recurring revenue.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Apple launches ‘Creator Studio’ bundle of apps for $12.99 per month
description: The bundle includes access to Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, and Pixelmator Pro on Mac and iPad, as well as Motion, Compressor, and MainStage on Mac.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Deepgram raises $130M at $1.3B valuation and buys a YC AI startup
description: Deepgram is raising its Series C round at a $1.3 billion valuation.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Slackbot is an AI agent now
description: Salesforce unveils Slackbot, a new AI agent that allows users to complete tasks across multiple enterprise applications from Slack.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Brazil orders Meta to suspend policy banning third-party AI chatbots from WhatsApp
description: Brazil's competition watchdog has ordered WhatsApp to put on hold its policy that bars third-party AI companies from using its business API to offer chatbots on the app. The agency has also started an investigation against the company to determine if the policy is anti-competitive.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Converge Bio raises $25M, backed by Bessemer and execs from Meta, OpenAI, Wiz
description: AI drug discovery startup Converge Bio raised $25 million in a Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with additional backing from executives at Meta, OpenAI, and Wiz.
author: Kate Park

title: Meta-backed Hupo finds growth after pivot to AI sales coaching from mental wellness
description: Hupo, backed by Meta, pivoted from mental wellness to AI sales coaching for banks and insurers, and secured a $10M Series A led by DST Global
author: Kate Park
